crosswalks.label: Quality Control Systems Managers
crosswalks.rationale: Quality Control Systems Managers is a bounded occupational baseline for Quality Manager; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Quality Management must keep quality-system conformance, corrective-action status and direct product/domain quality evidence as separate layers.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make administrative-quality-versus-direct-quality, CAPA-effectiveness and criteria-ownership boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Quality Manager reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
